title: Jack Black and members of Metallica play Iron Maiden tribute as the band and Oasis skip the Rock Hall
summary: Neither of the two British bands attended their own induction in Los Angeles.
body:
Iron Maiden and Oasis were both inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame on Saturday 14 November, but neither band attended the ceremony in Los Angeles.

In Iron Maiden's absence, an all-star group performed their 1983 song "The Trooper". It included the actor and musician Jack Black, St. Vincent, Metallica's Kirk Hammett and Robert Trujillo, Rage Against the Machine drummer Brad Wilk and guitarist John 5.

Other moments

Liam and Noel Gallagher of Oasis also stayed away. Peter Hook, the only member of Joy Division and New Order to attend, played "Love Will Tear Us Apart" with Deftones, and Billy Idol performed with Gwen Stefani.

Sources: Consequence, Billboard, Associated Press.
